prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1344; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can refer to me as the claimant.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot in Pearland, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling into a space near the entrance when another vehicle backed out of a spot and hit the driver's side of my car.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt, and how fast were you going?
A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. I was going very slowly, maybe walking speed, because I was looking for a spot.
Q: Did you hit anything inside the vehicle?
A: My knee struck the lower part of the dashboard when the impact happened. I felt a sharp pain right away.
Q: Did you get out of the car and speak with the other driver?
A: I got out, yes. The other driver apologized and said they didn't see me coming. We exchanged insurance information.
Q: Did you seek medical attention afterward?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. They X-rayed my knee and told me it was badly bruised and possibly sprained. I was given a brace and told to stay off it for a while.
Q: Have you had any problems with that knee before this incident?
A: No, not that I can recall. I'd been running a few times a week without trouble.
Q: Are you currently working or doing your normal activities?
A: I've been limited. I can't drive for long periods, and my job involves standing, so I've had to take time off while I recover.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still in physical therapy and I'm willing to provide my medical records.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
